name: Hieroglyph texts
_about: WALLS OF TEXT (glyphs.js renderTexture): an X x Y grid of quadrats filled by seed from a `pool` of signs (categories or codes, with weights, times each sign's own freq), packed as scribes pack them; `lines` columns or rows, `face` the way the signs look (left, right, alternate lines, random), `mode` a way of painting all of them (colors.json modes; none: each sign in its own colours), `ground` and `divider` / `border` colours, `cartouche` the chance of a name in its ring (one a line at most). A pattern layer { kind: 'hieroglyphs', texture } lays one on a building's wall (patterns.js).
